nodes.summary: For every natural number $l \ge 2$, there are only finitely many pairs of natural numbers $(n, x)$ with $n! + 1 = x^2$ such that $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ has fewer than $l$ distinct prime divisors.
nodes.title: Brocard–Ramanujan solutions with $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ having few prime factors are finite

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$, $l \ge 2$ and $m \ge 1$ be natural numbers and let $P \in \mathbb{Z}[X_1, \ldots, X_m]$. Write $F_k P_l$ for the set of products $y z$ of a $k$-free number $y$ and a positive integer $z$ with fewer than $l$ distinct prime divisors. Then there are only finitely many pairs $(n, x)$ of a natural number $n$ and an integer $x$ such that $n! + 1 = x^2$ and $x = x_1 \cdots x_m P(x_1, \ldots, x_m) + 1$ or…
nodes.title: Finitely many Brocard–Ramanujan solutions of polynomial shape

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k \ge 2$, there are only finitely many pairs of natural numbers $(n, x)$ with $n! + 1 = x^2$ such that $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ is $k$-free.
nodes.title: Brocard–Ramanujan solutions with $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ power-free are finite

nodes.summary: If natural numbers $n$ and $x$ satisfy $n! + 1 = x^2$ and $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ is a prime power, then $(n, x) = (4, 5)$.
nodes.title: Brocard–Ramanujan solutions with $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ a prime power

nodes.summary: If natural numbers $n$ and $x$ satisfy $n! + 1 = x^2$ and $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ is $7$-free, then $(n, x)$ is one of $(4, 5)$, $(5, 11)$ and $(7, 71)$.
nodes.title: Brocard–Ramanujan solutions with $x - 1$ or $x + 1$ seven-free

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $x$ be a positive integer dividing $n!$. Write $K(x)$ for the largest exponent in the prime factorization of $x$, with $K(1) = 0$. Then $x \le \exp(3 n K(x) / 2)$.
nodes.title: Divisors of a factorial bounded by their largest prime exponent

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $x$ be a positive integer dividing $n!$, and write $\omega(x)$ for the number of distinct prime divisors of $x$. Then for every positive integer $a$, $x \le n^{n/a} (a \, \omega(x) + 1)^{n \, \omega(x)}$, where $n^{n/a}$ is a real power.
nodes.title: Divisors of a factorial bounded by their number of prime factors

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
